A1.justification: Both readable ten-page PDFs describe the same EReCu study, with matching sections, six figures, two tables, and equations. Neither contains an appendix; both mention supplementary hyperparameter studies that are absent from the supplied PDFs.

before.justification: Section 4 reports original EReCu evaluations on four camouflage-detection benchmarks, qualitative predictions, and component ablations in Table 2.

after.justification: Section 4 retains the original benchmark evaluations, qualitative predictions, and component-ablation results.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same teacher–student framework, MNP, PEF with EPL and STAF, and LPR. The correction of equation delimiters does not change the algorithm or losses.

E1.justification: Both train on CAMO-Train and COD10K-Train and evaluate on CHAMELEON, CAMO, COD10K, and NC4K. The qualitative examples and represented test scenarios are retained.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains the same six UOS and four UCOD baselines. Figure 6 corrects 'UCOS-DPL' to 'UCOD-DPL,' matching Table 1 and reference [36]; this is a label correction, not a replacement comparator.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 retains identical training and evaluation sample counts, four evaluation metrics, DINO-ViT-S/8 configuration, and training settings, including 25 epochs and batch size 32.

E4.justification: Table 2 retains the same component combinations and ablation results on CAMO and COD10K. The attention-head analysis in Figure 5 and qualitative comparisons in Figure 6 test the same questions with the same examples.

E5.justification: Both state that all experiments use random seed 2026. Neither adds repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All scores and rankings in Tables 1–2 are unchanged. Figures 5–6 retain the same qualitative findings; Figure 6's resampling and corrected labels do not introduce new results.

T1.justification: Equation 8 gains missing closing parentheses after its two Dice-loss terms. This repairs typesetting without changing the intended mathematical expression or reasoning; the remaining definitions and derivations are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about pseudo-label reliability, structural detail, boundary accuracy, and state-of-the-art performance.

C2.justification: The explanations of native-cue guidance, pseudo-label evolution, attention selection, and component complementarity are unchanged. No new applicability qualifications, failure conditions, or limitations are introduced.

D1.justification: The extractors, thresholds, EMA momentum, optimizer, hardware, software versions, and baseline-reimplementation information remain unchanged. Both provide the same code link and references to supplementary hyperparameter details.

R1.justification: Both cite the same 41 works and retain identical research positioning. Reference [10] expands 'ICLR' to 'International Conference on Learning Representations,' which is bibliographic wording rather than a citation addition.

P1.justification: Local wording corrections expand 'Img' to 'Image,' correct the UCOD-DPL label, and spell out a conference name. The arXiv version/date stamp also changes; body prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 6 has corrected labels, resampled panels, and small positioning adjustments. Equation 8 receives closing parentheses, and references reflow across pages 9–10. No figures or tables are added or removed.

improvement.justification: Restoring Equation 8's missing delimiters and correcting Figure 6's comparator label modestly improve readability and attribution consistency. These are limited presentation improvements; the method, empirical evidence, claims, and reproducibility information remain unchanged.
